baseline_comparison.decision_gate_analysis: test-four-tier-conflict.sh IS one of run-all.sh's five documented LOAD_SENSITIVE_BASENAMES (test-lake-build-guard.sh, test-state-write-concurrency.sh, test-state-write-regen-timing.sh, test-four-tier-conflict.sh, test-run-all-parallel.sh), which always run serially BEFORE the parallel pool regardless of --jobs value -- this task's change cannot place it in new resource contention it wasn't already exposed to. The failing assertion is case 6, a budget-bound timing check (elapsed_ms vs budget_ms=1000), sensitive to ambient host load (file-lock contention from concurrently-dispatched sibling agent sessions), not to --jobs. The VERIFY_DEPLOY_GATE8_JOBS=1 rerun reproduces the Phase 2 baseline's exact 4-suite set, including this suite failing again under forced-sequential conditions identical to the baseline's own -- demonstrating the variance is ambient-load noise intrinsic to an already-known load-sensitive suite, present under BOTH --jobs=1 runs taken ~40 minutes apart, and simply absent in the one --jobs=auto run taken in between. The plan's own Risks & Mitigations table frames this exact risk as 'a suite fails... (real contention, NOT the known set)' -- i.e. the trigger condition for escalation is a NEW load-sensitive suite outside the known five, not variance within it. DECISION: PROCEED to Phase 5. This finding is disclosed prominently (here, in the Phase 4 plan-checklist annotation, and will be carried into the implementation summary) rather than normalized away, per the task's explicit instruction to report differences -- but is not escalated as a blocking user_decision, since it is inside, not outside, the known five.

wall_time_reduction.context: task 261's own run-all.sh-only battery numbers: 507.9s -> ~212s (58%). This run's full verify-deploy.sh (gate8 + 19 other gates) shows a slightly lower percentage because the ~2-3 minutes of non-gate8 gates are fixed cost diluting the parallel speedup fraction, and both this task's runs ran under heavier ambient concurrent-session load than task 261's dedicated flakiness-gate runs.
